_comment: CareCall Retell Agent Configuration & Dashboard Setup Guide

tools.name: get_clinic_info
tools.description: Retrieve clinic operating hours, location, contact information, and emergency protocol.

tools.name: list_doctors
tools.description: List active doctors at the clinic, optionally filtered by medical specialty (e.g. General Physician, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Cardiology, Orthopedics, Gynecology).

specialty.description: Medical specialty filter such as General Physician, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Cardiology, Orthopedics, Gynecology

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Find open appointment slots for a specific doctor or specialty across a date range. Never invent slots that this tool does not return.

date_from.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format in clinic timezone (Asia/Kolkata)

date_to.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format in clinic timezone (Asia/Kolkata)

part_of_day.description: Optional preferred part of the day

tools.name: find_patient
tools.description: Search for an existing patient record by E.164 phone number.

phone.description: Patient phone number in E.164 or 10-digit format

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a confirmed appointment atomically with exclusion-constraint protection. Returns a confirmation code.

patient_name.description: Full legal name of the patient

phone.description: Patient phone number in E.164 format

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the requested appointment slot

reason.description: Brief description of the patient's symptoms or visit reason

idempotency_key.description: Unique turn identifier to guarantee no duplicate bookings

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move an existing appointment to a new date and time. Phone number must match file.

confirmation_code.description: The unique confirmation code, e.g. APT-7482

phone.description: The patient registered phone number for identity verification

new_starts_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the new slot

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel an existing booking after verifying the confirmation code and registered phone number.

phone.description: Registered patient phone number for verification

dashboard_setup_checklist: 1. Log in to your Retell AI Dashboard at https://beta.retellai.com.
2. Navigate to 'Agents' in the left sidebar and click 'Create New Agent'.
3. Select 'Custom LLM / Single Prompt' and name your agent 'Maya - CityCare Receptionist'.
4. Under Voice, choose a warm natural voice like ElevenLabs 'Adrian' or 'Rachel'.
5. Copy the entire contents of 'agent/system-prompt.md' and paste it into the 'System Prompt' editor box.
6. Under 'Custom Tools / Functions', add the 7 tools listed above in the 'tools' array.
7. For each tool URL, replace '{{APP_URL}}' with your live public deployment URL (e.g., https://your-app.run.app).
8. In the Custom Headers field, add 'X-Tool-Secret' with the secret string configured in your TOOL_SECRET environment variable.
9. In 'Webhook Settings', paste your Webhook URL: {{APP_URL}}/api/webhooks/retell, and select events: 'call_started', 'call_ended', 'call_analyzed'.
10. Copy your Retell API Key from the 'API Keys' tab and Agent ID, then set RETELL_API_KEY and RETELL_AGENT_ID in your Secrets panel.
11. Click 'Save Agent' and test using the 'Test Call' simulator in the Retell dashboard or in the CareCall Live Demo tab.
